# Third-party work

## SFace face embedding model (Apache-2.0) — https://huggingface.co/opencv/face_recognition_sface
Converted to Core ML by `Tools/convert_sface.py`.

## MiniFASNetV2-SE anti-spoofing model (not included)
The code can load https://github.com/facenox/face-antispoof-onnx (Apache-2.0 repository, derived from
minivision-ai/Silent-Face-Anti-Spoofing). It was trained on CelebA-Spoof, offered for non-commercial
research, so neither this repository nor the downloadable app includes it.
